description: Lists the Croatian counties (županije), regions (Dalmacija, Istra, Kvarner, Slavonija...) and towns that have public pages, with their keys and page counts. Use a county or region key as "county" and a town key as "town" in search_businesses. Businesses that work all over Croatia count for every place.

county.description: A county key (for example "splitsko-dalmatinska"): only its towns are listed.
